findings.description: AC5 keeps the brainstorm's '>= 30% reduction across the 1086-row corpus' target verbatim, but the planner's preliminary measurement shows ~1% on the current 498-row corpus and US-001 only escalates when reduction is below 5%. An autonomous implementer cannot tell whether <30% is a failure, a question, or acceptable.
findings.resolution: AC5 rewritten as a decision gate. The 30% target is preserved as ASPIRATIONAL only; the real release gate is (a) zero unsafe coalesces (safety floor, must always hold) + (b) percent_reduction >= 5% OR operator decision recorded via kind=question on three options (A) proceed / (B) defer / (C) widen corpus. US-001 emits the kind=question and pauses subsequent stories.

findings.sectionRef: Acceptance Criteria > AC1 and Approach > Architecture > step 5
findings.description: AC1 says a /crews:review-mail invocation emits a stderr warning when count >= 3, but the plan also acknowledges 'slash invocations don't surface stderr to the operator at all'.
findings.resolution: AC1 split into AC1a (CLI: stderr + log line) and AC1b (Slash: log line only, NO stderr). Approach > Architecture step 4 (rewritten) now passes args.output into the wire-in block and gates the stderr write on args.output === 'cli'. Section 8 (slash-vs-CLI stderr asymmetry) explicitly documents it. AGENTS.md US-011 inherits the documentation requirement.

findings.sectionRef: US-009 (D-002 telemetry) and Approach > Architecture > step 5
findings.description: D-002 telemetry fields listenerExit and turnBoundaryCount are not implementable from the current collapseReviewRows signature.
findings.resolution: Telemetry derivation moved to the review-mail.js call site (US-005), NOT inside the pure collapse helper (US-004). Call site reads manifest (already in scope at review-mail.js:184) and derives listenerExit = manifest.terminationReason || manifest.listenerState || 'unknown' (terminationReason exists in v1.9+; fallback chain documented). turnBoundaryCount = new Set(group.memberConsumedAts).size (the pure helper already provides memberConsumedAts in each collapseGroup entry). Approach > Architecture section 9 documents the data sources. US-009 ACs updated.

findings.description: US-001 dependsOn=[] but plan says it 're-measures with the actual implementation's collapse logic'. The actual logic is built in Phase 2/3.
findings.resolution: Re-labeled US-001 as 'heuristic pre-measurement' (inlines its own key-builder; runs in Phase 1 with no dependency). Added US-012b 'faithful verification re-measurement' inside ship-and-docs cluster (Phase 4) that imports the real buildCollapseKey from lib/collapse-key.js and reproduces the measurement. US-012b also flags the heuristic as inaccurate if percent_reduction differs by more than 2 percentage points, and re-asserts the safety floor using the real helper. Implementation Strategy section + Preliminary Story Decomposition table + Suggested Decomposition (US-012 entry) all updated.

findings.description: process.stderr.isTTY predicate doesn't fire under spawnSync, so the gate would suppress warnings in every test invocation.
findings.resolution: Approach > Architecture > step 4 (rewritten) uses args.output === 'cli' as the stderr gate, NOT process.stderr.isTTY. Section 8 makes this explicit. US-008 ACs require two CLI-form spawn tests + two slash-form tests to verify the asymmetry.

findings.description: collapsedIds[] ambiguous for proactive batches — collapsed proactive entries would report the same parent inbox id.
findings.resolution: Approach > Architecture section 5 specifies collapsedIds[] uses the leaf-id chain row.reportId || row.outboxId || row.id. US-004 ACs require a unit test asserting the chain. US-005 ACs add a regression test using a proactive-batch row with 3 identical payload.entries[] verifying collapsedIds[] carries 3 distinct leaf reportId values, not the shared parent id. AC13 added.

findings.description: command-args-parity.test.js stderr assertion + deprecation wrapper stderr interaction would corrupt collapse-warning assertions.
findings.resolution: US-005 ACs explicitly require new parity-test cases to invoke the dispatcher form (node tools/crews.js review-mail ...), NEVER the deprecated wrapper (node tools/review-mail.js ...). AC14 added.

findings.description: US-010 framed manual marketplace edits as a separate required step; bump-version.js already handles them.
findings.resolution: US-010 reworded to use 'node ai-developer-toolkit/plugins/crews/scripts/bump-version.js 3.6.0' as the canonical atomic command for the 6 stamping locations. Manual edit is now scoped to the codexu-root AGENTS.md table row only (which is OUTSIDE bump-version.js scope). AC11 updated.

findings.description: Proposed pure helper not pure if it parses env, reads plugin version, appends logs, writes stderr.
findings.resolution: Architecture rewritten with two-layer split: lib/collapse-review-rows.js stays PURE (returns {collapsedRows, collapseGroups}, no I/O); all side effects (env reads, version reads, appendLog, stderr writes, manifest reads) happen at the review-mail.js handler call site. US-004 ACs explicitly require purity (no fs require, no appendLog import, no process.env read, no process.stderr write, no manifest read). US-005 ACs specify the side-effect wiring at the call site.

AC4 rewritten with 4-condition boundary: (a) JSON stdout byte-for-byte identical INCLUDING key order and absence of collapsed* fields, (b) zero stderr output, (c) zero new 'review-mail collapse:' lines in crews.log, (d) cursor advancement byte-identical. US-007 ACs require a regression test asserting all four conditions explicitly.

findings.description: Claude reviewer claimed tests/review-mail-command.test.js and tests/command-args-parity.test.js do not exist. VERIFIED INVALID.
findings.resolution: Claude reviewer hallucination. Files verified to exist via `ls ai-developer-toolkit/plugins/crews/tests/` returning both files (output of bash probe earlier in session). Researcher agent referenced tests/review-mail-command.test.js:81-185, 295-410 and tests/strict-ack-review-mail.test.js:9-36 and tests/command-args-parity.test.js:21-39, 131-212 with specific line numbers. Codex reviewer also confirmed line 191-196 of command-args-parity.test.js exists. No plan change required; finding is rejected as hallucination.

findings.description: Verbatim brainstorm quote includes 'version from package.json' which is stale.
findings.resolution: Added a 'Planner clarification (F-012)' footer block immediately after the In Scope section that reiterates: (1) stderr-when-count>=3 applies ONLY to CLI invocations (split into AC1a/AC1b), (2) version source is .claude-plugin/plugin.json via the new lib/version.js helper (crews has NO package.json). Verbatim quote preserved for brainstorm-traceability with the explicit clarification that the implementation MUST follow the planner clarification.
